comment: SBFIN-4 check_encoding known failures. SHRINK-ONLY: max_entries is pinned at creation and may never rise; the checker fails in code if entries exceed it, if an entry lacks an owner, or if a listed entry NO LONGER fails (remove it). CORRECTED AT SBE-RERUN-1 (2026-08-09): this comment previously claimed the entry would stop failing the moment the elections chain re-ran. The chain re-ran and it did NOT. The decoder fix prevents NEW corruption only; it cannot repair a value already persisted, because ingest_ie builds dname_idx from existing donor names (ingest_ie.py:232) and resolve_donor (:248-260) returns the existing donor id on a norm() match without ever refreshing `name`. norm() collapses both U+0092 and U+2019 to a space — the same property that keeps the donor id stable is what guarantees the stale display name is matched and kept. Repair requires a name-refresh path in ingest_ie.resolve_donor, which is its own lane (it would refresh every donor's display name from the bulk on every run, changing the alias-not-rewrite posture and touching PS-97's territory). Until that lands, this entry persists and the pin correctly keeps failing.
